name: UX
title: UniFi Express
summary: Tiny USB-C Cloud Gateway + WiFi 6 AP for very small networks; Network app only, 4 devices.

extra.software_note: Network 9.0 is the last major train; 9.1+ requires UniFi Express 7

gotchas: Not in store / legacy: Ubiquiti says Network 9.1+ needs UniFi Express 7 — buy UX7 instead.
Only 1 WAN + 1 LAN at 1GbE and no IDS/IPS listed — gigabit-ish ISP ceiling, no security inspection.
Manages just 4 UniFi devices and hosts Network only (no Protect/Access) — outgrow it with UCG-Ultra/Max.
No PoE output; any AP or switch beyond it needs its own power.
best_for: meshing as an extra AP in an existing UniFi network
